address.description: The host or host:port at which the database can be reached.
address.title: Server Address

advanced.description: Options for advanced users. You should not typically need to modify these.

backfill_chunk_size.description: The number of rows which should be fetched from the database in a single backfill query.
backfill_chunk_size.title: Backfill Chunk Size

dbname.description: The name of database to connect to. In general this shouldn't matter. The connector can discover and capture from all databases it's authorized to access.
dbname.title: Database Name

discover_schemas.description: If this is specified only tables in the selected schema(s) will be automatically discovered. Omit all entries to discover tables from all schemas.
discover_schemas.title: Discovery Schema Selection

feature_flags.description: This property is intended for Estuary internal use. You should only modify this field as directed by Estuary support.
feature_flags.title: Feature Flags

heartbeat_interval.description: This property is deprecated and will be removed in the near future. Has no effect.
heartbeat_interval.title: Heartbeat Interval

node_id.description: Node ID for the capture. Each node in a replication cluster must have a unique 32-bit ID. The specific value doesn't matter so long as it is unique. If unset or zero the connector will pick a value.
node_id.title: Node ID

rediscovery_interval.description: How often the connector re-runs discovery while a capture is running to notice schema changes and newly added tables. Accepts duration strings like '15m' or '1h'. Defaults to 15m when unspecified.
rediscovery_interval.title: Rediscovery Interval

skip_backfills.description: A comma-separated list of fully-qualified table names which should not be backfilled.
skip_backfills.title: Skip Backfills

skip_binlog_retention_check.description: Bypasses the 'dangerously short binlog retention' sanity check at startup. Only do this if you understand the danger and have a specific need.
skip_binlog_retention_check.title: Skip Binlog Retention Sanity Check

source_tag.description: When set the capture will add this value as the property 'tag' in the source metadata of each document.
source_tag.title: Source Tag

ssl_client_cert.description: Optional PEM-encoded client certificate for mutual TLS.
ssl_client_cert.title: SSL Client Certificate

ssl_client_key.description: PEM-encoded private key for the client certificate.
ssl_client_key.title: SSL Client Key

ssl_server_ca.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate the server certificate must chain to. Required for 'verify_ca'. Optional for 'verify_identity', which otherwise trusts public certificate authorities and the CAs of Amazon RDS and Google Cloud SQL (shared CA).
ssl_server_ca.title: SSL Server CA

sslmode.description: Whether to use TLS and how strictly to verify the server certificate. Defaults to 'required'. See the connector documentation for details.
sslmode.title: SSL Mode

statement_timeout.description: Overrides the default statement timeout used by the connector. The default of zero disables statement timeouts entirely.
statement_timeout.title: Statement Timeout

watermarks_table.description: This property is deprecated and will be removed in the near future. Previously named the table to be used for watermark writes. Currently the only effect of this setting is to exclude the watermarks table from discovery if present.
watermarks_table.title: Watermarks Table Name

advanced.title: Advanced Options

password.description: Password for the specified database user.
password.title: Password

aws_role_arn.description: AWS Role which has access to the resource which will be assumed by Flow
aws_role_arn.title: AWS Role ARN

gcp_service_account_to_impersonate.description: GCP Service Account email for Cloud SQL IAM authentication
gcp_service_account_to_impersonate.title: Service Account

gcp_workload_identity_pool_audience.description: GCP Workload Identity Pool Audience in the format //iam.googleapis.com/projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/test-pool/providers/test-provider
gcp_workload_identity_pool_audience.title: Workload Identity Pool Audience

azure_client_id.description: Azure App Registration Client ID for Azure Active Directory authentication
azure_client_id.title: Azure Client ID

azure_tenant_id.description: Azure Tenant ID for Azure Active Directory authentication
azure_tenant_id.title: Azure Tenant ID

discoveryFilters.description: Options that restrict which tables are visible to discovery.

exclude_schemas.description: Tables in the listed schemas will be excluded from discovery.
exclude_schemas.title: Exclude Schemas

include_schemas.description: If specified only tables in the listed schemas will be discovered. Combined as a union with the 'Discovery Schema Selection' setting under Advanced Options.
include_schemas.title: Include Schemas

table_patterns.description: If specified only tables matching at least one of these glob patterns will be discovered. A pattern containing a '.' matches against the qualified 'schema.table' name. A pattern without a '.' matches the unqualified table name in any schema. Use '*' or '?' as wildcards.
table_patterns.title: Table Patterns

discoveryFilters.title: Discovery Filters

historyMode.description: Capture change events without reducing them to a final state.

networkTunnel.description: Connect to your system through an SSH server that acts as a bastion host for your network.

privateKey.description: Private key to connect to the remote SSH server.
privateKey.title: SSH Private Key

sshEndpoint.description: Endpoint of the remote SSH server that supports tunneling (in the form of ssh://user@hostname[:port])
sshEndpoint.title: SSH Endpoint

networkTunnel.title: Network Tunnel

timezone.description: Timezone to use when capturing datetime columns. Should normally be left blank to use the database's 'time_zone' system variable. Only required if the 'time_zone' system variable cannot be read and columns with type datetime are being captured. Must be a valid IANA time zone name or +HH:MM offset. Takes precedence over the 'time_zone' system variable if both are set (go.estuary.dev/80J6rX).
timezone.title: Timezone

user.description: The database user to authenticate as.
user.title: Login Username

advanced.description: Options for advanced users. You should not typically need to modify these.

additional_backfill_filter.description: Optional filter clause which will be applied to all backfill queries for this binding. Contact Estuary support for assistance before using this option.
additional_backfill_filter.title: Additional Backfill Filter

advanced.title: Advanced Options

mode.description: How the preexisting contents of the table should be backfilled. This should generally not be changed.
mode.title: Backfill Mode

namespace.description: The schema (namespace) in which the table resides.
namespace.title: Schema

priority.description: An optional integer priority for this binding. The highest priority binding(s) will be backfilled completely before any others. The default priority is zero. Negative priorities are allowed and will cause a binding to be backfilled after others.
priority.title: Backfill Priority

stream.description: The name of the table to be captured.
stream.title: Table Name
